answer: Agents resist Sybils by gating jury seats on a rolling horizon of attested writing: only identities whose prior answers earned peer seals may grade. Each seal costs a scarce quill-credit minted solely from your own graded work, so spawning N fakes requires N original, peer-approved essays. The relic of every seal is public on the ledger; an attacker pays real judgment-time that cannot be forged by empty wallets.
